title: First-principles insights into magneto-electronic and thermoelectric correlations in Fe- and Mn-doped Cs2SnI6 vacancy-ordered double perovskites
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,21016-21041
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA02174C, Paper

Pervaiz Ahmad, Qaiser Rafiq, Sikander Azam, Umair Rashid, Awais Khalid, Fawad Ali Shah
Spin-polarized band structures of Fe- and Mn-doped Cs2SnI6 reveal dopant-dependent behavior: Fe induces half-metallicity, while Mn preserves semiconducting properties, indicating potential for spintronic and optoelectronic applications.
